newsitem.title: USA: Perrigo sales up after severe cold season.
newsitem.headline: Perrigo sales up after severe cold season.

text.p: A severe cold, cough and flue season led to double-digit sales increases of over-the-counter pharmaceutical and nutritional products at Perrigo Co and strong fiscal second quarter results, the company said Tuesday.

"The quarter was a very good quarter with excellent sales growth and solid margins. In fact, this was our most profitable quarter in over two years." Chairman and CEO, Mike Jandernoa said in a statement.

The maker of non-prescription drug, personal care and nutritional products for the store brand market earned net income of $13.7 million, or $0.18 a share, on revenues of $221.7 million. A year ago, the company earned $12.2 million, or $0.16 a share, and revenues of $200.9 million.
Second quarter gross margins were 28.3 percent of sales, versus 27 percent a year ago and 26.1 percent in the first period, due to higher OTC sales levels.

"As we pass through the peak of the cough, cold, and flu season, with the resulting product mix changes, we would expect gross profit margins to decline somewhat from the second quarter levels," Jandernoa said.
